{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=Varies|time=60 minutes|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southern_cuisine|Southern U.S. Cuisine]]

==Ingredients==

* 4 medium [[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potatoes]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 4 Granny Smith [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], peeled, cored, and sliced
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 3 Tablespoons apple juice or [[Cookbook:Cider|cider]]
* 3 Tablespoons melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]

==Procedure==

# Arrange sliced sweet potatoes, apples, and raisins in a greased 2-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]].
# Mix the liquids and butter together. Pour over the dish's contents.
# Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 350°F for 30 to 45 minutes, until sweet potatoes are tender and glazed.
